# Story 65 — KB-002 Categories & Article Management (Story: CRM-65)

## Prerequisites

- KB-001 completed: the knowledge base article module already exists — see `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseArticle.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseDbContext.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseEndpoints.cs`, `frontend/CRM.Web/src/stores/knowledgeBase.ts`, `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/knowledgeBase/views/KnowledgeBaseManagementView.vue`, `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/customerPortal/views/PortalKnowledgeBaseListView.vue`.
- AUTH-003 role/permission plumbing in place — see `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/Permissions.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/RolePermissions.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/Roles.cs`.
- Coordination: no active parallel work on the KB module. All KB endpoint routes are grouped in `backend/CRM.Api/Program.cs`.

---

## Story Goal

Add a **flat, non-nested** knowledge base **category** taxonomy so managers can organize articles and customers can browse them by topic:

1. Manager-facing CRUD (`create`, `edit`, `activate/deactivate`) at `/knowledge-base/categories`.
2. Server-side article filtering by `categoryId` (do **not** filter in Vue memory).
3. Article ↔ category relationship: one required category per article, only **active** categories selectable at assignment time; existing articles keep their category when it is deactivated.
4. Customer portal shows only **active** categories that contain **published** articles, with a server-computed article count and a per-category article listing page.
5. Category permissions enforced server-side. Arabic/English + RTL/LTR supported.

**Not in scope:** nested categories, tag/taxonomy, AI categorization, article migration on deactivation, hard-delete of categories.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current:** articles carry a free-text `category` string (or no category link).
- **New:** articles reference exactly one `KnowledgeBaseCategory` via `CategoryId` (required). Only **active** categories are selectable at create-time and when changing an article's category. If an article's current category is **inactive**, the article keeps it and continues to render; the manager can move it to an active one, but not back to the inactive one via the picker.
- **New:** categories are never hard-deleted through the UI. Use activate/deactivate.
- **New:** customer portal hides categories that are inactive **or** have zero published articles.
- **New:** article listing supports server-side `categoryId` filter.

### 3 — Category endpoints

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseCategoryEndpoints.cs`

- Route group: `/api/knowledge-base/categories`, all endpoints `.RequireAuthorization(...)`.
- `GET /` — list all categories (managers/editors). Return `KnowledgeBaseCategoryListResponse`. Optional `?activeOnly=true` for the article-form picker consumed by agents.
- `GET /{id:guid}` — single category or `404`.
- `POST /` — create. Validate `Name`: trimmed, non-empty, `<= 120` chars; description `<= 1000`. Reject duplicate by `LOWER(name)` (return `409 Conflict`). Default `IsActive = true`. Set `CreatedAt`/`UpdatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`.
- `PUT /{id:guid}` — update name/description with the same validation.
- `PATCH /{id:guid}/status` — accept `UpdateKnowledgeBaseCategoryStatusRequest`, update `IsActive`, bump `UpdatedAt`.
- Enforce `EF.Functions.ILike` or `.ToLower()` comparisons for duplicate check; wrap the write path in a `try/catch DbUpdateException` to translate the unique-index violation into `409`.
- Authorization:
  - Read: `Permissions.KnowledgeBaseCategories.View`.
  - Write: `Permissions.KnowledgeBaseCategories.Manage`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty / whitespace-only name:** backend rejects with `400`; front-end form disables Save. Enforced in `KnowledgeBaseCategoryEndpoints.cs` create/update handlers.
- **Duplicate name (case-insensitive):** backend returns `409 Conflict` from the unique index; front-end surfaces the toast "Category name already exists." (i18n key `knowledgeBase.categories.errors.duplicate`).
- **Category not found:** all `GET/PUT/PATCH /{id}` return `404`.
- **Deactivating a category with articles:** allowed; articles remain associated; article-list still shows them; `Category` object on the article still surfaces `isActive: false`.
- **Attempting to create an article with an inactive category:** backend rejects with `422`; front-end filters inactive categories out of the picker.
- **Editing an article whose current category is inactive:** form shows the inactive category label read-only; saving without changing category is allowed; switching to an inactive category from an active one is blocked in UI **and** on the server.
- **Article referencing a category that has been hard-deleted (inconsistent state):** `Include(a => a.Category)` yields `null`; API returns `category: null` and article stays reachable. UI shows "—" and lets the manager reassign.
- **Category with zero articles:** shown in management view; hidden from customer portal (server-side filter).
- **Concurrent update:** last-write-wins on name/description; the unique-index duplicate check still applies. Do not add optimistic concurrency for the MVP but log a warning if the update touches 0 rows.
- **DB failure on save:** endpoint returns `500` with a generic message; UI shows "Unable to save category. Please try again." Do not surface raw exception text.
- **Unauthorized calls:** `RequireAuthorization` policy returns `403`. Frontend hides menu but server is the source of truth — covered by `RbacEndpointEnforcementTests.cs` pattern.
- **Arabic / RTL:** category names are user content; do not normalize casing across scripts beyond `ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)`. Verify Arabic names do not collide with English ones erroneously.
- **Half-applied migration state:** the migration seeds an `Uncategorized` row then flips `CategoryId` to `NOT NULL`. If it fails after the seed, re-running the migration is idempotent (guard the seed with `IF NOT EXISTS`).

## Migration / Rollback

- Migration name: `AddKnowledgeBaseCategories`.
- Order: create table → seed `Uncategorized` row → add nullable `CategoryId` to articles → backfill → set `NOT NULL` → add FK + indexes + unique index on `Name`.
- **Rollback:** `dotnet ef database update <previous>` reverses the migration. Because `CategoryId` becomes `NOT NULL`, ensure the down migration drops the FK/index/column in reverse order.
- **Half-applied state risks:** if the process dies between "backfill" and "NOT NULL", re-running the migration must re-seed only if missing (guard with `WHERE NOT EXISTS`) and re-backfill only NULL rows.
- Do **not** drop or rename the old free-text `Category` column in this story if it exists — leave it in place under a `Legacy` name and remove in a follow-up.
